_doc: Weights and parameters for bot_score.py. Bump `version` on every change and log why in knowledge/scoring.md: a scored result records the version that produced it. Weight 0 = computed and reported, but not part of phi.

params._doc_ability: Used only when neither the tracker (army_em, army_m_per_bp) nor the team army mix priced from unit_catalog.json gives the figure. Defaults = median T1 ground unit in the catalog.
params._doc_v2: v2 (2026-09-24, checked against knowledge/game_mechanics.md): energy_stall weight 0 (1.2: a controlled stall is ideal); income usable = spend_capacity (1.1: all spending is BP x cost/buildtime = pull); army rate caps lab support BP (2.5); AA risk has a prior before enemy air is seen (7.3); commander risk stakes the rest of phi (1.5, 9). See knowledge/scoring.md.
params._doc_v3: v3 (2026-09-24): everything valued at metal + energy/70 (game_mechanics 2.3): army and defence at full cost; income capital adds the energy the builders use alongside their metal spending (their own E/M mix) / 70. Energy nothing can use counts only at surplus_value.
